issues.detail: The check `contains ${DOC} /audience/i` assumes the record uses the word 'audience'. The template's per-surface bullet starts with 'Audience, purpose, file/section', so a correct run almost certainly writes it. A run that records readers another way (for example 'For operators: ...') would fail the check without a judge looking at it.
issues.fix: Acceptable as is. If the check misfires, widen the regex to `audience|reader|operator|developer`.
